title: Page 7
content_zh:
放下管家含泪递给他过目的府内开支清单，斐思年的两眼，久久停顿在伙食费用那庞大的金额上头没法挪动。

他深吸了口气，再接连灌光了两壶茶水，这才稍稍恢复了呼吸的平顺度，可偏偏就在这时，府中掌杓的大厨却跑来向他禀报，府里储存好用来过冬的肉品已经全数用罄，必须赶在过节之前重新采买补齐……

身为一家之主，斐思年在痛定思痛过后，立即做出个对他、也对合家上下来说，可谓再明智不过的决定。

次日清早，顶着漫天不断飘落的雪花，斐然与尚善分别捧着行李茫然地站在府门外的大街上，而休沐日不必上朝的斐思年，在关上府门前只赏赐了他俩一句话。

“本官的俸禄养不起你们！”以后还是不要回来好了。

遭人无情踢出府的某两个吃货，互看彼此一眼，然后颇有自知之明地摸摸鼻子，乖乖爬上知书准备好的远程马车打道回山。

回山的漫长路途上，闲得没事也得找事做的他俩，不是常缩在一块儿睡觉打发时间，就是斐然看由知书送来的帐本，她看她的经书。

这日她侧躺在车厢的长椅上，头枕着他温暖的大腿翻阅着经书时，斐然漫不经心地勾起她披散的发丝，低首看着愈来愈焕采美丽的她。

自从补齐魂魄后，尚善整个人看上去与以往有着些许的不同，她的眼眸格外光彩明亮，心性也更加开朗，好像因魂印所带来的那些阴影都已由她的生命中散去，他已有许久没再见她在梦呓或是在梦中流泪，那些属于她的过去，彷佛已是真的过去了。

“善善。”

“嗯？”她正揉着因看书看得两眼有点酸涩的眼。

“你……还记得你上辈子的事情吗？”清远真人同他解释过魂印现象的由来，也因此，他一直都很担心，她还会惦记着她上一世死前之事。

听着他声音里隐藏着的担忧，尚善微微扬起眼睫，坐起身将手中的书搁在一旁。

“只记得一些。”为什么他这个人总是这么别扭呢？无论做什么事都那么爱拐弯抹角。

“同我说说。”他将滑下去的毛毯拉上来为她盖好，把她给包得严严实实的。

她侧首靠在他的肩膀上，心下有些好笑，因她上辈子太过短暂的人生，真没有复杂到可以让他如此如临大敌的程度。

她已经不知那是几百年前的事了，当时尚年幼的她，一直都长在深闺之内，所以她并不晓得天下众国，也不知外头的世界变化，她就只是一个小国的相府千金，父母与众姨娘眼中的掌上明珠。

只可惜好景不长，在她七岁那年，先皇骤逝后引发政变，她的父亲自入朝以来就效力于皇帝与太子，因此当太子在登基失败被杀之后，相府自是第一个遭到叛党清洗的对象。

当相爷死在宫中的音讯传至府里，身为相国夫人的娘亲便已命府中所有人换白衣缟素，眼看着抄家之人已经快要抵达，在娘亲的令下，府中女眷纷纷自尽，她则是被二姨娘抱在怀中给灌了睡药。

她是被掐醒的。

生生痛醒过来的她，瞠大了眼，又惊又痛地看着最为疼爱她的二姨娘，就这么泪流满面地死命掐着她的颈项。

“好孩子，别怕……姨娘陪你一块儿上路……”

没过一会儿，事先已吞金的二姨娘，因受不住腹中痛苦而后继无力，二姨娘方才松手，她的亲生娘亲，已含泪地过来将她压在床上，接手使劲地再掐……

斐然完全无法理解她们为何要那么做。

“为什么？”生命是如此珍贵，在面临抄家的那等情况下，那位夫人所该想的，应该是如何让自个儿的女儿活下去吧？

她深吁了口气，语气淡淡地说着。

“为保全相府名节不被任何人污辱。”事发前，她是听姨娘这么说的。

斐然没想到她的上一世是如此惨烈收场，可是在为她感到唏嘘之余，又很庆幸，她能回应魂纸的呼唤重新再来到世上一次，不然，他也没能这么幸运的找到她。

“现在你还会梦到当年的事吗？”

“没再梦到过了。”也许补齐魂魄对她来说，最大的用处就是在于淡忘上一世的记忆与伤痛，在她的不知不觉间，她已能回首淡看那一段久远前的往事。

斐然这下子总算是彻底放心了，搂着身子暖呼呼的她，他的身心也跟着放松了下来，心情甚好的他，甚至还构建起日后的梦想。

“改日我带你去各国走走，吃遍你爱吃的美食——”

梦想被人截断，“不回道观了？”

“呃……”一想起清罡真人那只恶龙，他不得不退一步，“好吧，我会与清罡真人商量，每年让你下山放放风，总不能让你在山上闷坏了是不？”

尚善沉默了一会儿，攥紧了拳头，音调有些不稳地问。

“……为什么对我这么好？”

斐然没注意到她的异状，还以指点着她的俏鼻，“不待你好些，我怕你不要我啊。”

她定定地看着他，眼眸闪烁着难以言喻的情绪，半晌，她在心中默默做了决定后，放软了身子深深地倚向他。

身下的马车速度缓缓减慢了下来，斐然听着车外熟悉的脚步声，皱眉地

“何事？”

“三爷。”达礼站在马车外低声禀报，“云取宫的人又来了。”都已经派来第三拨人马了，真有够阴魂不散的。

斐然冷眸微眯，“打发掉。”

“是。”

在马车重新上路时，尚善好奇地把头探向车窗外。

“你是不是有什么事瞒着我？”怎么最近常看他和知书与达礼神神秘秘的？

斐然将她拉回怀中，并伸手关上窗扇，轻描淡写地一语带过。

“嗯……只是件微不足道的小事，并不重要。”既然纳兰清音说过，这是清罡真人与云取宫之间的旧怨，那么他们这些小人物就不必掺和了，阴谋与权力这些东西，根本就不需要再次出现在她新生的生命里。

第8章(1)

再次站在极山道观熟悉的山门前，一块儿看着山门尽处那似藏在云朵里头的宫殿，无论是尚善或是斐然，都没了先前赶路时的急迫心情，反而各自长吁短叹了起来。

“进去后又要吃素了……”在尝过皇宫和皇爷府的极品荤菜后，尚善一想到观里那食而无味的素菜，她就愁眉苦脸的。

“能够冲动的机会就更少了……”斐然则是在想，观里有着那班老道士在，他要想窃玉偷香什么的，恐怕都得躲躲藏藏地避着他们。

她开始想敲退堂鼓，“你说这时叫回知书他们的马车来不来得及？”

他积极鼓励她奔向自由，“不如咱们回山下的镇子住上一段日子再上山？”

清罡真人冷淡的声音，如鬼如魅地窜进他俩的讨论声中。

“进个门都要这么罗罗唆唆，要不要本道助你俩一臂之力？”

僵怔在原地的两人怯怯地看向他们的身后，等得不耐烦的清罡，也不给他们挣扎的机会，直接一手拎起一个奔向山顶上去。

打牌打累了，暂时待在极悟堂内烤火休息边吃着橘子的清远真人，在清罡提着一大一小来到殿上时抬起头来，他随即绽出笑容，朝那两个不情不愿回来的人招招手。

看过尚善的魂魄状态后，清远真人满意地颔首。

“嗯，不错。”

尚善忧心忡忡地问：“师公，斐然他把魂魄给了我，日后对他会不会有什么影响？”
content_en:
Putting down the butler's tearful hand to him with a list of household expenses, Feisinian's eyes paused for a long time on the huge amount of food expenses, unable to move.

He took a deep breath and poured two pots of tea in succession, finally regaining the smoothness of his breathing. But at this moment, the chef in charge of the mansion came to him and reported that all the meat stored in the mansion for the winter had been used up, and he had to buy new ones before the festival...

As the head of the family, Feisinian immediately made a decision that was wise for him and the whole family after he learned from the pain.

Early the next morning, under the snowflakes that continued to fall all over the sky, Fei Ran and Shang Shan stood blankly on the street outside the mansion with their luggage respectively. Feisinian, who did not have to go to court on holiday, only rewarded them with a word before closing the door of the mansion.

"I can't afford to support you with my salary!" It's better not to come back in the future.

The two foodies who were kicked out of the house mercilessly looked at each other, then touched their noses with self-knowledge, and obediently climbed into the long-distance carriage prepared by Zhishu and headed back to the mountain.

On the long way back to the mountain, the two of them had nothing to do but found something to do. They often huddled together to sleep to pass the time, or they would read the account books sent by Zhishu and she read her scriptures.

That day, she was lying on her side on the bench in the carriage, her head resting on his warm thigh while she was reading scriptures. Fei Ran casually lifted up her disheveled hair and looked down at her, who was becoming more and more radiant and beautiful.

Since replenishing her soul, Shang Shan looks a little different than before. Her eyes are particularly bright and bright, and her temperament is more cheerful. It seems that the shadows caused by the soul mark have been dissipated from her life. It has been a long time since he saw her talking or crying in her sleep. The past that belongs to her seems to have really passed.

"Good, good, good."

"Huh?" She was rubbing her eyes, which were a little sore from reading.

"Do you...remember what happened in your last life?" Master Qingyuan had explained to him the origin of the soul mark phenomenon. Therefore, he had always been worried that she would still be thinking about what happened in her previous life.

Listening to the worry hidden in his voice, Shang Shan raised his eyelashes slightly, sat up and put the book aside.

"I only remember a few." Why is he always so awkward?No matter what he does, he loves to beat around the bush.

"Talk to me." He pulled up the blanket that had slipped down and covered her, wrapping her tightly.

She leaned her head on his shoulder, feeling a little funny in her heart, because her previous life was too short, and it was not complicated enough to make him feel like a powerful enemy.

She no longer knew that it happened hundreds of years ago. She was still young at that time and had been growing up in a deep boudoir, so she didn't know about all the countries in the world or the changes in the outside world. She was just the daughter of a prime minister of a small country, the apple of her eye in the eyes of her parents and aunts.

Unfortunately, the good times did not last long. When she was seven years old, the sudden death of the late emperor triggered a coup. Her father had served the emperor and the prince since he entered the court. Therefore, after the prince failed to ascend the throne and was killed, the Prime Minister's Office was the first target to be purged by the rebel party.

When the news of the Prime Minister's death in the palace reached the mansion, her mother, who was the wife of the Prime Minister, ordered everyone in the mansion to change into white clothes and plain clothes. Seeing that the raiders were about to arrive, under her mother's order, all the female relatives in the mansion committed suicide one after another. She was held in the arms of the second aunt and given sleeping pills.

She was pinched awake.

When she woke up from the pain, her eyes were wide open, and she looked at the second aunt who loved her the most in shock and pain, and she was squeezing her neck with tears streaming down her face.

"Good boy, don't be afraid...my aunt will accompany you on the journey..."

After a while, the second aunt who had already swallowed the gold was unable to bear the pain in her belly. The second aunt just let go. Her biological mother came over with tears in her eyes and pressed her on the bed. She took over and pinched her hard again...

Feiran couldn't understand why they did that.

"Why?" Life is so precious. When faced with a house raid, what the lady should be thinking about is how to keep her daughter alive, right?

She took a deep breath and spoke calmly.

"To protect the reputation of the prime minister's house from being insulted by anyone." She heard this from her aunt before the incident.

Feiran didn't expect her last life to end so tragically, but while feeling sad for her, he was also very lucky that she could answer the call of the soul paper and come back to the world again. Otherwise, he wouldn't be so lucky to find her.

"Do you still dream about what happened back then?"

"I haven't dreamed about it again." Perhaps the greatest use of replenishing her soul is to forget the memories and pain of her previous life. Before she knew it, she was able to look back on that long-ago past.

Feiran finally felt relieved now. Holding her warm body, his body and mind relaxed. He was in a good mood and even started to dream about the future.

"Someday I will take you to travel around the world and eat all the food you like -"

The dream was cut off by someone, "Aren't you going back to Taoism?"

"Uh..." When he thought of Master Qinggang's evil dragon, he had to take a step back, "Okay, I will discuss with Master Qinggang and let you go down the mountain for fun every year. I can't let you get bored on the mountain, right?"

Shang Shan was silent for a while, clenched his fists, and asked with an unsteady tone.

"...Why are you so nice to me?"

Feiran didn't notice her strange behavior and pointed at her pretty nose, "If I don't treat you better, I'm afraid you won't want me."

She looked at him steadily, her eyes flashing with indescribable emotions. After a while, she silently made a decision in her heart, then relaxed her body and leaned deeply against him.

The carriage beneath him slowly slowed down. Feiran frowned as he listened to the familiar footsteps outside the carriage.

"What's the matter?"

"Third Master." Dali stood outside the carriage and reported in a low voice, "The people from Yuntori Palace are here again." The third group of people has already been sent, and the ghost is really lingering.

Feiran narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Send it away."

"Yes."

When the carriage got back on the road, Shang Shan curiously poked his head out of the window.

"Is there something you're hiding from me?" Why do you often see him, Zhishu and Da Li acting mysteriously recently?

Fei Ran pulled her back into his arms, reached out to close the window sash, and conveyed her in an understatement.

"Well... it's just a trivial matter, not important." Since Nalan Qingyin said that this was an old grudge between Qinggang Zhenren and Yuntori Palace, then little people like them don't have to get involved. Things like conspiracy and power don't need to appear again in her new life.

Chapter 8(1)

Standing in front of the familiar gate of Jishan Taoist Temple again, we looked at the palace at the end of the gate that seemed to be hidden in the clouds. Whether it was Shang Shan or Fei Ran, they no longer felt the same urgency as when they were rushing on their way. Instead, they each sighed.

"You have to be vegetarian again after you go in..." After tasting the top-notch meat dishes in the palace and the Emperor's Mansion, Shang Shan frowned when she thought of the tasteless vegetarian dishes in the temple.

"There are even fewer opportunities to be impulsive..." Feiran was thinking that there were those old Taoist priests in the temple. If he wanted to steal jade and incense, he would probably have to hide and avoid them.

She started to want to back off, "Do you think it's too late to call Zhishu and his carriage back at this time?"

He actively encouraged her to run towards freedom, "Why don't we go back to the town below the mountain and live there for a while before going up the mountain?"

Master Qinggang's cold voice penetrated into their discussion like a ghost.

"You have to be so rude and instigative when you enter the door. Do you want me to help you two?"

The two people who were frozen on the spot looked timidly behind them. Qinggang, who was waiting impatiently, did not give them a chance to struggle, and directly picked up one in one hand and ran to the top of the mountain.

Tired from playing cards, Qingyuan Zhenren, who was temporarily staying in Jiwu Hall to warm himself by the fire and eat oranges, raised his head when Qinggang came to the hall with one big and one small. He then smiled and waved to the two people who were reluctant to come back.

After seeing Shang Shan's soul state, Master Qingyuan nodded with satisfaction.

"Yeah, not bad."

Shang Shan asked worriedly: "Master, Fei Ran gave his soul to me, will it have any impact on him in the future?"
